displayAddress: New York Square, Quarry Hill, Leeds
description:
*No students for 2026 academic year. 

With tech-enabled living, and health and well-being intrinsic to what we do, this is renting like never before. Deposit alternative available, fuss-free living, pet-friendly homes in the heart of Leeds cultural quarter. Not just bespoke interior designed apartments, but also state-of-the-art amenities including private dining room, residents' lounge, co-working spaces, media room, 24-hour gym and two rooftop BBQ terrace.

So what are you waiting for? Reserve your new Moda home in Leeds NOW

YOUR APARTMENT
- Perfectly designed for sharers
- 2 x equal sized bedrooms, each with private en-suite
- Situated on either side of an open plan, shared living space
- No shared bedroom walls - reduced noise and greater privacy
- Open plan living with 3-seater sofa and lounge chair
- Fitted kitchen with dining space for four

YOUR KITCHEN
Open plan, sleek and modern with quartz worktops and integrated appliances including touch control, ceramic, 4-ring induction hob, oven, microwave, stacked fridge and freezer and dishwasher. Additional washer/ dryer within utility cupboard. Room to entertain with a dining table in marble effect and four chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA
Light and spacious with stylish herringbone blackout curtains. Plush three-seater sofa, media storage unit and large coffee tables with mirrored tops.

YOUR BEDROOMS
Stylish bedrooms including bespoke fitted wardrobes with full height mirror, hanging rail and storage. Ottoman bed with storage, feature headboard and 1,000 individual pocket sprung mattress made from natural materials and marble effect bedside tables.

YOUR BATHROOMS
En-suite bathrooms with contemporary porcelain tiling throughout. Deluxe sized rainfall shower with separate handheld shower, WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting.

Council Tax Band: D

Please note that utilities (including electricity, water, and heating, depending on your apartment), council tax, TV licence, parking (if required), and any optional extras or upgraded services are not included within your monthly rent.

Speak to our team to discuss the homes and offers currently available.
